clarity-session.headline: One hour. One clear next step.
for: Practitioners who want a plan, not a pitch
Anyone about to spend money on the wrong thing
clarity-session.alt: Writing an action plan by hand
faq: What happens after the hour?
You receive a concise written action map the same week: the decision, the sequence and the tools to use.
Is it online?
Yes. Sixty minutes on a video call, recorded on request.
What if I need more?
The session fee is credited against any audit or sprint booked within 30 days.

brand-content-audit.headline: How your brand actually lands.
for: Practices about to refresh their look
Teams who want an honest outside read
faq: What do you review?
Your website and social channels: message, consistency, tone and calls to action.
What do I get?
A scored audit, ranked priorities and a 45-minute debrief.

website-visibility-audit.headline: Where do visitors give up?
for: Sites that get traffic but no enquiries
Owners who want fixes they can run themselves
website-visibility-audit.alt: Graphics tablet and laptop in use
faq: Do you fix things?
The audit is diagnosis plus a 30-day plan. Fixes can be booked as a sprint or by the hour.
How long does it take?
Five working days from access to debrief.

revenue-ready-sprint.headline: Selling in weeks, not quarters.
for: An offer that is ready but has no page
A launch with a date attached
A first paid product for an established practice
faq: Why is it a launch rate?
R7,500 is the introductory rate for the fixed scope. It rises once the first cohort of sprints is complete.
What is not included?
Domains, hosting, ad spend, complex integrations, full brand identity and unlimited revisions.
How fast?
Scope confirmed in writing first, then the build runs to an agreed launch date.

visibility-conversion-sprint.headline: Found, understood and chosen.
for: Brands with a budget for a focused month
Sites that need a conversion refresh
faq: Is ad spend included?
No. Advertising spend is paid separately by you; we set up and run the campaign.
What are the 12 assets?
Campaign graphics and copy across feed, story and email, built on one message.

landing-page.headline: One page, built properly.
landing-page.alt: Designer's desk with laptop and graphics tablet
faq: Do you write the copy?
Yes, copy and design are both included.
Hosting?
Quoted separately or set up on your existing platform.

content-starter-pack.headline: A month of posting, decided in a week.
for: Practitioners who stop posting by week three
content-starter-pack.alt: Colour pencils arranged in a circle
faq: Which platforms?
Graphics are sized for Instagram and Facebook; captions adapt to LinkedIn.
Can I edit them?
Yes, files are delivered as editable templates.

brand-identity.headline: A brand that looks like the work you do.
for: Rebrands after a change of direction
Teams who need templates, not just a logo
brand-identity.alt: Graphics tablet and laptop in use
faq: Starter or Signature?
Starter (R2,800) for a solo practice; Signature (R5,500) when you need a full suite and guideline.
Revisions?
One consolidated round on Starter, two on Signature.

bespoke-content-pack.headline: Original graphics, not templates.
for: A quarter of posting in one delivery
bespoke-content-pack.alt: Designer's desk with laptop and graphics tablet
faq: How many infographics?
Up to four, approved at concept stage before design.

growth-desk.headline: The work that never quite gets done.
for: Brands that need consistent output and a monthly read
faq: Is there a minimum term?
Retainers are payable monthly in advance; a three-month initial term is recommended.
What if I need more hours?
Additional work is billed at R1,500 per hour or as a prepaid block.

social-media-management.headline: Consistent, on brand, every week.
for: Brands with source content to adapt
Owners who want reporting, not guesswork
faq: Why 'from'?
Five tiers from Essentials to Signature; cadence and rate are confirmed on enquiry.

executive-support.headline: Senior hands, by the hour.
for: Leaders who need implementation, not advice
executive-support.alt: Designer's desk with laptop and graphics tablet
faq: How does the block work?
Ten prepaid hours at R10,000, applied across agreed priorities and reported monthly.

podcast-starter.headline: Start the show properly.
for: Practitioners with an audience and no format
faq: Do you produce episodes?
Episode production is quoted separately once the format is set.

podcast-concept.headline: Audience, format, launch plan.
for: Shows that stalled after a pilot
Formats that need a guest strategy
faq: What do I receive?
A format document: audience, purpose, episode structure, guest strategy and launch plan.

podcast-launch.headline: A launch people can find.
for: Shows that need a page and a pathway
faq: What is tracked?
Page visits, follows and the pathway from listener to enquiry.

campaign-command-centre.headline: One place where the campaign lives.
for: Teams who need one dashboard and one report
faq: What is separate?
Venue hire, catering, performers, transport, ticketing charges, technical suppliers, printing and paid advertising, unless expressly included.
How is it priced?
From R12,500, confirmed after a short brief.

event-marketing.headline: Fill the room, report the result.
for: Events that need a listing and a pathway
faq: Ticketing?
We set up the pathway; ticketing platform charges are paid by the organiser.

screening-campaign.headline: Put the film in front of people.
faq: What is included?
Film positioning, ticketing, campaign hub, partner mobilisation, social assets and reporting.

workshops.headline: AI, content and conscious leadership, taught in a day.
faq: Where?
Cape Town in person, or online.
Half or full day?
From R7,500 half day, from R12,500 full day; content is adapted to the group.
